content: ईश् €2 <ab>Ā.</ab> (ईष्टे, ईशाञ्चके, ऐशिष्ट, ईशिता, ईशितुम्, ईशित) .²1 To rule, be master of, govern, command (with <ab>gen.</ab>); नायं गात्राणामीष्टे <ls>K. 312</ls> <ab>v. l.</ab>; अर्थानामीशिषे त्वं वयमपि च गिरामीश्महे यावदर्थम् <ls>Bh. 3. 30</ls>; sometimes with <ab>acc.</ab>; इमाँल्लोकानीशत ईशनीभिः <ls>Śvet. Up. 3. 1</ls>. (also used in the Veda with <ab>gen.</ab> of an infinitive or <ab>loc.</ab> of an abstract noun). .²2 To be able, have power; expressed by ‘can’; माधुयर्मीष्टे हरिणान् ग्रहीतुम् <ls>R. 18. 13</ls>, <ls n="R.">14. 38</ls>; कमिवेशते रमयितुं न गुणाः <ls>Ki. 6. 24</ls>; <ls>U. 7. 4</ls>; <ls>Śi. 1. 38</ls>; <ls>Māl. 10. 13</ls>. .²3 To act like a master, allow. .²4 To own, possess. .²5 To belong to.
ईश् {%m.%} A master, lord, the Supreme Spirit. ईशावास्यमिदं सर्वम् <ls>Īśop. 1</ls>.
